a.lede: Whoop is launching a social network that lets members share their sleep, recovery, and workout data, but the bigger bet is on becoming more of a personal health brand, with CEO Will Ahmed hinting at acquisitions to come.
a.title: Whoop just launched a social network

b.title: Whoop Humans is a social network designed for fitness enthusiasts
